column1: # Values match the checkout. When debt decreases, lower this baseline. It is not
# a universal size limit and cannot justify new debt. Never raise it.
# Legacy daemon coordinator: delegate more responsibilities before it grows.
# QML coordinator with mixed responsibilities: its next change must extract.
# CXX-Qt contract concentrated by the macro; logic remains in submodules.
# Legacy local Qt controls may migrate to shared style but never grow.
